schemes.name: Micro Finance Scheme (సూక్ష్మ రుణ పథకం)
schemes.agency: National Backward Classes Finance & Development Corporation (NBCFDC) / State Corporations
schemes.eligibility: Rural target group micro-entrepreneurs with annual family income up to ₹3,00,000.
schemes.security: Hypothecation of assets created out of loan; self-help group guarantee or personal guarantee.
schemes.description: Tailored for nano-entrepreneurs, dairy smallholders, and rural shopkeepers requiring capital up to ₹1.40 Lakh with subsidized interest.

schemes.name: Term Loan Scheme (టర్మ్ లోన్ పథకం)
schemes.agency: National Backward Classes Finance & Development Corporation (NBCFDC)
schemes.eligibility: Rural micro and small entrepreneurs setting up viable enterprises up to ₹50 Lakh.
schemes.security: Hypothecation of assets created + suitable third-party guarantee or collateral as per channelising agency guidelines.
schemes.description: Comprehensive long-term financing for enterprise scaling, commercial dairy units, handloom clusters, and processing mills with 6-month initial moratorium.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana — Shishu (ముద్రా శిశు)
schemes.eligibility: Small micro-enterprises at start-up or nano stage.
schemes.security: Collateral-free (covered under Credit Guarantee Fund for Micro Units - CGFMU).
schemes.description: Government of India flagship collateral-free micro credit for seed operations and small business tools.

schemes.name: Stand-Up India Scheme (స్టాండప్ ఇండియా)
schemes.eligibility: SC, ST, and Women entrepreneurs setting up greenfield manufacturing, services, or agri-allied trading enterprises.
schemes.security: Hypothecation of assets created + CGSSI credit guarantee.
schemes.description: Facilitates bank loans between ₹10 Lakh and ₹1 Crore to promote enterprise ownership among underserved communities.

schemes.name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
schemes.eligibility: Any individual above 18 years; at least 8th standard pass for projects > ₹10 Lakh in manufacturing.
schemes.description: Credit-linked subsidy scheme offering 25% - 35% margin money subsidy for rural enterprises.
